canonical_project: Blue Swan AI Gigafactory / Conn Barracks data center
owner: Blue Swan consortium: Free State of Bavaria, Leibniz-Rechenzentrum/BAdW, Investa; Blue Swan Service GmbH planned as operator vehicle
notes: Bavarian government describes Blue Swan as an AI Gigafactory concept in the EU competition, using the Schweinfurt site for available land, grid power, and fiber, with LRZ as coordinator/competence holder and Investa contributing data center development expertise. District/Geldersheim planning pages document the Conn Barracks Blue Swan land-use process. The 220 MW figure appears in public planning consultation material quoting project assumptions; other official pages emphasize 100,000 GPUs but do not state MW.
